usage:
hergy - run a team of agents on top of herdr

Usage: hergy <command> [options]

Run a team
  up [definition]          Start a team
  down [team]              Stop a team, and close the workers it hired
  status [team]            Show how the members and workers are doing
  refresh <member>|--all   Restart a member; its conversation starts empty
  reprompt <member>|--all  Send the bootstrap prompt again; the conversation stays
  hire <name>              Add a worker

Team definitions
  new <definition>         Write a starter team definition
  ls                       List the team definitions
  show <definition>        Show the final team definition and where each value came from
  validate                 Check the settings files

Other
  cheat [--ai]             Show the cheatsheet
  version                  Show the version

Common options
  --dry                    Show what would happen, and do nothing
  --as <team>              Run the same team definition under another team name (up only)
  --team <team>            The team for refresh, reprompt and hire
  --global / --local       Use only the global or the project team definitions
  -C <dir>                 Use this directory as the project
  --lang en|ja             Language of the output (default en)

Options hire needs
  --profile <profile> --purpose <purpose> --task "<task>" [--from <member>]

Where team definitions live
  Project                  .hergy/teams/<definition>/team.yaml
  Global                   ~/.config/hergy/teams/<definition>/team.yaml
cheat.people:
hergy cheat

First time
  hergy new myteam  Write a starter team definition
  edit team.yaml    Write the members and the agents they run
  hergy up myteam   Start the team (--dry to only look)

Everyday commands
  Start a team                     hergy up [definition]
  Stop a team                      hergy down [team]
  See how the team is doing        hergy status [team]
  Restart a member                 hergy refresh <member>
  Send the bootstrap prompt again  hergy reprompt <member>
  Add a worker                     hergy hire <name> --profile P --purpose X --task "..."
  List the team definitions        hergy ls
  Look at a team definition        hergy show <definition>
  Check the settings               hergy validate
  Show the version                 hergy version

Where team definitions live
  Project  .hergy/teams/<definition>/team.yaml
  Global   ~/.config/hergy/teams/<definition>/team.yaml

All options: hergy --help. For an agent: hergy cheat --ai

error.new_needs_name: hergy new needs a team definition name

error.not_under_herdr: run inside a Herdr-managed shell pane (HERDR_ENV=1 and HERDR_PANE_ID are required)

  path: %s

error.herdr_name_pattern: the name with the team prefix (the herdr name) must match [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}: %q

error.docs_missing: docs: no such file or directory: %s
error.prompt_empty_team: prompt must be a nonempty string
error.name_pattern: %s.name must be a short name matching [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31} (the team name is added automatically)
error.needs_profile_or_kind: %s needs a profile or a kind
error.must_be_mapping_not_null: %s must be a mapping, not null
error.not_plain_kind: %s must be a plain agent kind
error.no_role_file_no_dirs: no role file for %s (there is nowhere to look; put the role file in the team definition's roles/ or point roles at a directory)
error.profiles_moved: (team.yaml no longer has profiles; profiles live in profiles.yaml)
error.no_may_spawn: %s has no may_spawn in the config
error.live_names_in_use: live agent names already in use: %s
error.herdr_agent_object: unexpected Herdr response: agent is not an object
error.live_mismatch: %s: live name/kind does not match the config
error.live_name_mismatch: %s: live agent name does not match the config
error.reset_before_refresh: %s: status=%q; wait until the agent is idle or done
error.refresh_self: %s runs in your own pane; a member cannot refresh itself. Run it from another pane, or as the human
error.refresh_no_pane: %s: no pane is named after it; run `hergy down` then `hergy up`
error.refresh_pane_busy: %s: the pane named after it is running something else (pane %s); run `hergy down` then `hergy up`
error.herdr_not_advertise: installed Herdr does not advertise %s %s; inspect `herdr %s`
error.herdr_no_result: Herdr response has no result object
error.herdr_not_string: unexpected Herdr response: %s is not a string
error.herdr_not_number: unexpected Herdr response: %s is not a number
error.kill_failed: %s: cannot stop the running process group: %v
error.agent_not_gone: %s: herdr still knows the agent after %d ms; it was not restarted
launcher.boot_submitted: prompts: submitted (document reading continues in each pane)
down.would_close_worker_self: %s: would close (pane %s, worker, own pane; last)
progress.kept: note: existing panes/processes are kept. A failed request may already have taken effect.
progress.inspect: note: inspect live state before retrying; bootstrap prompts are never retried automatically.
herdr.guide_member:
- To a member: `herdr agent prompt <name> "<text>"`. Start the text with "%s".
- To the human: write in your own pane.
- For anything else: `herdr agent --help`.
- To add a teammate, use `hergy hire`, not `herdr agent start`: a teammate herdr starts directly is invisible to hergy's roster, `hergy down` and `hergy status`.
herdr.guide_worker:
- To a member: `herdr agent prompt <name> "<text>"`. Start the text with "%s".
- To the human: write in your own pane.
- For anything else: `herdr agent --help`.
- A worker adds no teammates: reach the others with `herdr agent prompt`, and ask the member that hired you if another worker is needed.

## Spawning workers
When needed, you may spawn workers for these purposes: %s
Profiles you may use: %s
How to spawn: `%s`
The worker starts in another tab; its herdr name is "<team>-<worker>". It reports back to you (%s) when done. Worker names are lower-case ASCII and must not collide with the roster.
